title: agentbay.config.yaml
description: Per-project user settings. modes.<name> is validated against that mode's config schema; connectors.<name> against the connector's config schema. Settings can only tighten mode constraints and env limits: a cap above the env's `limits:` is refused. Capabilities are bound only in envs/<env>.yaml; there is no config-level binding override.

agent.description: The runtime adapter (adapters/<name>/adapter.yaml) whose `profile:` runs every role: how one LLM product maps tiers to models. Default: claude-code.

approvals.description: Approval gates. chat: true lets `bay approve --via chat --quote ...` pass a gate without a terminal, relayed by the Chief of Staff and labelled user@chat-via-cos in the ledger. Default off.

plan.description: When forge.extend runs a planning step before the approval gate: for a large or security-sensitive proposal (the default), always, or never. The gate itself always runs and binds the plan with the proposal.

offline.description: true: every env that has an `offline:` block binds what that block lists (fake sources) and has no network and no secrets. Envs without the block are unchanged. Default false.

workflows.description: Project workflows: ordered stages composing mode endpoints, run via cos.run. Stage kinds are `call` (<mode>.<endpoint>) and `gate` (approval). `with`, `when`, $in.<field> and $steps.<id>.<field> mean what they mean in a feature's steps. `bay check` checks every target against the registry and every `with` against that endpoint's input schema.

in.description: JSON Schema for this workflow's own input, referenced as $in.<field>.

call.description: The endpoint this stage runs, as `bay call` spells it.

with.description: Input for the endpoint. $in.<field> and $steps.<id>.<field> are substituted; keys whose value is missing are dropped.

when.description: Skip the stage unless this value is truthy; a leading `!` skips when it is truthy instead. A gate takes no `when` (`bay check` refuses it).

gate.description: Approval gate: the run stops and only `bay approve` passes it. It takes no `when`.
